D.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced an Egg Hunt event on April 4th;
that the parade registration closes April 3rd and encouraged residents or organizations who want to
participate in the parade to register by the deadline.

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that they will hold a Junior Safety Fair on March 27.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Director, announced a block cleanup event on March 28; and provided
an update on the Street Rehabilitation Project.

F.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

Norma Tabares, City Attorney, reminded the Councilmembers about SB 827, expanding their training
requirements to include 2 hours of fiscal and financial training every two years.

G.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Mayor Pro Tem Roa asked about parade entries.

Mayor Del Rio wished everyone a happy Easter.

H.  CLOSED SESSION

There were no Closed Session items.

I.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 7:52 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting to be held
on Wednesday, April 8, 2026 at 6:00 PM.
